rejections.error: Partial support belongs to another model generation

process.earlier_best_test: separate CPU fixture; this actual CT run has one epoch
process.same_group_probe: separate numerical probe; this lifecycle has one batch per group

same_episode.fixture_scope: explicit repeat of one real query batch; not epoch coverage

ranking_contract.weight_rationale: Keep the existing observed-presence task and L2 alignment; add a unit-weight mean rank loss. User-approved ranking extension; weights are not claimed optimal.
ranking_contract.rank_pairs: all same-case positive/unobserved pairs touching the current physical minibatch
ranking_contract.zero_positive_case: retain observation auxiliary and L2 training; report unavailable within-case positive ranking
ranking_contract.positive_scope: all eligible small-tumor observation anchors in the preserved cache
ranking_contract.unknown_scope: not observed at candidate center; NOT a confirmed invalid CP placement
ranking_contract.overlap: any recipient tumor voxel under the actual transformed paste footprint

config.label_count_rationale: User-approved explicit observation task; not a speed-driven latent capacity reduction.
config.comparison_count_rationale: Reuse full 128-position candidate budget per patient and retain every eligible positive anchor.
config.cluster_min_patients_rationale: A discovered cross-patient submode needs evidence from at least two distinct support patients; this does not drop patients or graph nodes.
config.alignment_loss_weight_rationale: Equal-weight mean CE objectives as an explicit unvalidated starting design; requires ablation, not copied from SwAV.
config.production_limitation: Paired GNN has a dedicated cache/training runner. Native online bank/nnU-Net integration is not complete; old recipient-only caches/checkpoints cannot be relabeled.

execution_contract.checkpoint: atomic replacement after every optimizer/support batch; exact RNG, optimizer and episode plan

loader_calibration.cache_policy: one producer pool at a time; combined budget 20% available RAM
loader_calibration.worker_kind: production process prefetch; parent pin thread

limits: Earlier best before final epoch tested on CPU fixture, not multi-epoch CT run
Same episode full-model probe repeats one real CT batch; not multi-batch epoch coverage
Actual lifecycle is 8 train / 2 validation, 1 epoch, 4 updates
No native nnU-Net online integration or efficacy claim
